title: SIH internal hackathon
description: College shortlisting round on 22 September. The venue changed this morning.
submission: Form a team of 6 with at least one female member and shortlist problem statements
uncertainty: No start time has ever been given, only the date.
issue: The SIH portal still shows old problem statements and a different team size. The faculty coordinator says to proceed on verbal information and that the website will catch up.
deadlineText: internal hackathon date is 22nd, as announced in class
clashNote: Three things land on 22 September: this, the Neutron orientation (12-3 PM) and the University-Wide Hackathon registration deadline. No start time is given for this one, so an overlap with Neutron cannot be ruled out.

history.what: Team size confirmed as 6, minimum 1 female. Internal hackathon date announced as the 22nd - 'this is final'.

title: Semester registration
description: Two different closing dates were circulated and neither came from an official source. Worth checking.
submission: Verify your registration status with the department
uncertainty: Neither date is from an official source - both are students in a group chat.
issue: Two conflicting dates in one thread. One student says the portal says 30 September; another says the deadline was 'tomorrow', which would have been 4 September. Both cannot be right.
deadlineText: tomorrow is the last date for sem registration / I know the site says 30 Sept
